verdict.rationale: Zero's public GitHub repository (Mail-0/Zero) describes the product as open-source, and the source is publicly readable there, including raw docs, the contributing guide and devcontainer setup. A separate repository review also calls it an open-source, self-hostable app. missing for 10: the specific license name or terms are not shown in the evidence, and there is no independent confirmation of the license type.
